//engines: Kept at the major on purpose - Vercel rejects engines ranges finer than 'NN.x'. .nvmrc pins 22.23.2, and the floor is real: Node 22.x before the 2026-03 backport of nodejs/node#62040 has a stream/web TransformStream race that throws 'controller[kState].transformAlgorithm is not a function' when a pending write runs after cancel/close has cleared the algorithm (nodejs/node#62036). On 22.19.0 it crashed local signup submits 3 of 3 on 2026-09-11, before the request reached Supabase. An earlier note here called it disproven after passing runs on 22.19.0 - wrong, because it is a race: passing runs cannot rule it out, only the Node version can. 22.11.0 is also too old for the unit suite (require(esm) landed in 22.12). See app/tests/e2e/README.md.
